name: QuicksilverOne Rewards

apr.notes: Purchase rate 29.24% variable APR per the product page.

fx_fee.notes: Capital One states that it doesn't charge foreign transaction fees on any of its U.S.-issued credit cards.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back can be redeemed for any amount as a check, statement credit, to cover recent purchases, or for gift cards. Rewards don't expire for the life of the account.

notes: Fair-credit version of Quicksilver. Mastercard network per Mastercard's Capital One card listing (Capital One QuicksilverOne Cash Rewards Credit Card). network_tier is recorded as none because no official page names the Mastercard package.
